verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only thin, adjacent support: Brand Templates can be made accessible so teams create on-brand designs, and brand kits and templates can be accessed and managed, which amounts to sharing styles and templates across a team. Nothing shows reusable components published across files and projects, or any mechanism for controlled updates when the source changes. Missing for 10: component publishing across files/projects, controlled update propagation from source (accept/review changes), first-party docs on library behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
